The reader closes before the scoped mutation proceeds, so no full workspace image is materialized. BeginInstalledMetadataRead.reason: Bounded trusted-source lifetime primitive resolves default key and retains its exact installed logical generation under the same store/residency lock. An explicit Context pin now forks an independently admitted child descriptor from that generation instead of substituting a newer installed source; writes deliberately bypass read pins. Independently admitted handle and selected-response allowances remain charged until explicit idempotent Close; selection admission does not reuse a released parent lease. Off mode returns coverage error so callers retain their literal original off accessors. SW32 and TestScaleP21OwnedChildRead cover parent release, retained generations, changed defaults, cancellation, foreign bindings, close accounting, child budget denial and concurrent parent-close/child-acquisition. Persistent SQLite repeats and targeted race pass. This primitive review does not certify authorization handoffs or any old consumer.
